execution.host: One trusted Linux x86-64 test host with two cores and four hardware threads; client and evaluator were separate processes on it
execution.transport: local-process pipes; not a separate machine and not SSH

comparisonWithRetainedReplayReceipt.notMatched: The replay receipt ran its evaluator on a different, faster machine over SSH and replayed sequentially. Elapsed time, evaluator time and step time are not comparable between the two; only client replay time on the same client host class is.

timingLabelNote: The client report from this revision carried the replay route's timing label. On the checked route the sampled replay runs after the round trip and is not inside evaluatorRoundTripMs; the label is omitted from the evidence and corrected in the following revision.
limitations: One public four-token fixture on one host; not a latency distribution, a quality result or a separate-machine run.
The integrity mechanism bounds deviation and samples exact replay; it is weaker than full replay. See INTEGRITY.md.
No evaluator misbehaved in this run, so it shows completeness and cost, not detection. Detection is exercised by the tests.
The client host operator is trusted with plaintext and the secret key.
The retained full-replay receipts are unchanged.
